checks.rationale: Authoritative ordered suite and exact before/after revision binding work, but reproduced zero-test false passes violate AC1/AC2. Native Astra/xhigh rank4 submission is independent of retained Sol/xhigh rank3 owner; provider-effective identity/effort unavailable, as detailed in this report.

Flat Python 3.11 ports and declared exclusions are respected. Persisting sensitive configured argv violates the sanitized command-evidence boundary (002). The user decision supersedes the older manual two-review schedule, without changing frozen runtime ports.
Traced request authority, runner evidence, bounded verified logs, ordered receipts and final result. The regex selects unrelated count text and produces durable false success (001).

Execution, revision and persistence failures generally fail closed and temporary receipts are cleaned up. A 5,000-digit matched count escapes run as ValueError before after-observation/finalization (003).

Membership/order/rules, stale revision, unknown status, root/environment mismatch, bad receipt digest/read-back and actual child HEAD drift reject appropriately. Unrelated summaries and oversized numeric matches remain defective (001/003).

Independent declared leaf passes 10 meaningful tests without skips on exact candidate Windows3.12; hashed Windows3.11/Linux3.11 records likewise show10/no skips. Actual process/Git tests are meaningful, but all three reproduced defects need tracked regressions.

Typed internal command catalogue, suite membership, revision observer and local evidence collaborators fit the frozen port and owned validation slice. No downstream concrete Git/state/candidate/review/CLI implementation or dirty-tree policy is demanded.

Raw binary diff and three added paths verified against frozen base/head; no rename, deletion or unrelated source change. Owner FINAL bytes and accepted003/006 ancestry/bytes match. All context, validation, policy-model, graph/isolation and fingerprint checks pass.

Explicit flat-module typed collaborators directly implement accepted Validator.run and CommandRunner.execute DTOs; ordered results/evidence precede candidate formation without hash cycles. No shared schema fields, port changes or undeclared downstream imports were introduced.

Authoritative argv and environment binding names, accepted shell-free execution, bounded hashes, no-link path guards and durable read-back were checked. Sensitive argv is reintroduced into validation receipts after runner redaction (002).

Owned handoff accurately records scope/platforms and dependency limits, but final-standard-summary and handled failure claims are contradicted by001/003; receipt sanitization guidance must reflect002. Older separate R2 language is explicitly superseded by the bound user decision, not treated as an extra gate.

findings.description: validation.py:51,491-493,714-716 selects the final regex match after stdout/stderr concatenation instead of complete unittest result evidence. Two actual zero-test TextTestRunner processes exited0 with verified Ran0/NO TESTS RAN output, but unrelated diagnostic Ran7 text in stderr or a trailing historical excerpt produced passed checks and suite receipts with count7.
findings.expected_fix: Interpret the existing unittest_nonzero_count rule using complete standard summary/status evidence within streams; reject zero, missing, malformed or ambiguous proof without borrowing unrelated counts or treating concatenation as time order. Add tracked actual-process regressions and correct handoff claims; retain normal nonzero/zero discovery behavior and frozen success-rule contract.

findings.description: validation.py:735,802-806 always persists raw configured argv. An actual sensitive-argument probe was redacted by accepted006 in argv/logs and failed validation, but the durable configured_command.argv restored the synthetic sensitive value verbatim. Failed and pre-execution receipt paths can therefore retain credentials despite the accepted sanitized-evidence boundary.
findings.expected_fix: Sanitize configured argv against authoritative sensitive bindings on every persisted path, including when command evidence is absent; preserve non-sensitive argv exactly and do not allow redacted evidence to pass. Add tracked regressions checking all retained receipts and update the handoff.

findings.description: validation.py:492,714-716 converts an unrestricted matched count outside the failure boundaries. A real exit-zero child emitted a 5,000-digit count below the configured output byte limit; LocalValidator.run raised Python's conversion-limit ValueError and retained zero validation receipts, also bypassing after-revision observation and remaining-command collection.
findings.expected_fix: Bound numeric parsing and convert malformed/oversized output into nonpassing typed evidence without global interpreter-limit changes. Add a tracked actual-output regression asserting no exception, durable nonpassing receipts and collection of a later required command; update the handoff.
